expected.description: Saying an email isn't registered enables account enumeration; respond the same either way
Reset tokens are long, random, single use, and stored hashed
A one week link is too long; tokens should expire in minutes to hours and on use
Reset requests are rate limited to stop email bombing and brute force
Resetting the password signs out other sessions and notifies the user
The reset link is built from a configured base URL, not the request Host header
